_about: Which of the team's photos goes where. scripts/import-site-photos.js reads this, makes web-sized copies in images/<stop-id>/, and replaces each listed stop's "images" in data/stops.json, in this order (the first is the site's hero). Source files come from the team's "VDC Site Photos" folder, named <site>_<order>_<description>. Captions and credits come from the team's "copy and credit" PDFs (one per site, October 2026). permission: "team" = the team's own photo; "pending" = publishing permission not yet confirmed (see docs/image-permissions.md).

unsung-founders-memorial.alt: The Unsung Founders Memorial on a shaded quad: a round black tabletop held up by a ring of small figures, with stone seats around it.
unsung-founders-memorial.caption: The Unsung Founders Monument.

unsung-founders-memorial.alt: Close-up of the small figures beneath the memorial's tabletop, their arms raised to hold it up.
unsung-founders-memorial.caption: The Unsung Founders Monument, close-up.

unsung-founders-memorial.alt: The memorial's tabletop covered with bouquets of flowers, with potted plants on the stone seats around it.
unsung-founders-memorial.caption: Unsung Founders Memorial, decorated with flowers.

lenoir-hall.alt: Lenoir Hall today: a red-brick building with tall windows above wide stone steps, under a clear blue sky.
lenoir-hall.caption: Lenoir Hall.

lenoir-hall.alt: Two smiling women in matching navy polo shirts standing outside the entrance of South Building.

lenoir-hall.alt: A young Black man in a green jacket speaks into a microphone in front of students sitting on wide stone steps.

the-pit.alt: The Pit today: a sunken brick plaza with trees, tables, and chairs in front of the UNC Student Stores building.

steele-building.alt: Black-and-white photo of four men in suits seated in a circle, talking; one holds papers.
